caption: The drawing contains three main objects depicted in different scales on a light beige background. On the left, there is a detailed close-up of a carved bedpost finial, shaped like a pineapple with a patterned surface and a decorative tassel-like element at the base; this segment is labeled “HALF SIZE” beneath it. In the center-right, there is a perspective drawing of a wooden four-poster bed frame, shown without a mattress, featuring ornately turned and carved posts topped with pineapple finials, and curved headboard and footboard panels with scroll-like designs and gold circular embellishments at the corners; this object is labeled with a scale of "1½ inch = 1 foot". Below the bed frame, towards the bottom center of the image, is a round, gold-colored decorative floral or rosette ornament, labeled “ACTUAL SIZE”. The overall color scheme includes various shades of brown for the wooden objects and golden-yellow for the decorative embellishments, with line work and shading creating a three-dimensional, textured appearance for each item.
title: Bed
